infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: MeshChat requires Bluetooth access to discover nearby offline peers and relay end-to-end encrypted messages without cellular or internet connectivity.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: MeshChat uses Bluetooth Low Energy to advertise your local cryptographic mesh identity to nearby offline contacts.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: MeshChat uses Apple Multipeer Connectivity to establish zero-latency local Wi-Fi and Bluetooth mesh links with nearby devices.
